blocks.text: NAGA CITY, Philippines — The Philippine Anti-Corruption Czar (PACC), a civil society watchdog, is investigating the stalled construction of the Naga City Convention Center in Barangay Carolina after an inspection revealed rusting steel structures and vegetation covering the project site. The inspection, conducted on Nov. 15, followed complaints from concerned citizens. It was carried out by the PACC, together with personnel from the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Camarines Sur 3rd District Engineering Office.
